name: What is the process for planning an interior home renovation with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for planning an interior home renovation with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. We then move to design development, where we help you refine concepts, select materials, and create detailed plans. Following this, we provide a comprehensive proposal. Once approved, we handle permitting (if required) and schedule the construction phase. Clear communication and regular updates are integral throughout every step of your renovation journey.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design development, proposal, permitting, and construction, with continuous communication.
